head: 0e350e7b962b87782fd5e9344c40bdd0b02085bb

findings.issue: FIXED: id-only patches and patches repeating existing values reported changedSlides despite an unchanged spec, violating #13 AC4. changedSlides now compares pre/post slide values, ignores object-property order and preserves source-spec order; regression covers no-ops, nested changes and mixed patches.

FIXED: legal source IDs such as src:1 and src_1 (also . and ..) collapsed to one sanitized R2 path with the same filename, overwriting source content while storing separate hashes. Source ID segments now use injective percent encoding, including dots, without changing stored keys for existing records.

FIXED: putSourceObjects only returned uploaded keys after every upload succeeded, so a later invalid source or failed R2 write leaked earlier objects. The caller now shares its cleanup list with the uploader and registers every attempted key before writing, including the source map; regression exercises the public create callback and a write-then-error R2 failure.

needs-human: this #13 bugfix PR also introduces the complete unmerged PR #1 implementation (48 files versus main). The PR body documents the stack, so it is not hidden scope drift, but landing it also lands the inherited findings below. Decide whether #1 is the prerequisite landing unit or whether this PR owns its broader API/schema/runtime work; no branch rewrite was performed.

needs-human (#10, an explicit #13 non-goal): idempotency storage and request hashes omit authenticated ownerId. Two owners with identical tool/key/input can receive the same cached project result before the action performs ownership checks. Resolve owner-scoped key compatibility and existing-record migration in the dedicated issue.

needs-human (#9, an explicit #13 non-goal): claimJobs selects only queued jobs but claiming changes them to running. Expired running jobs are never requeued, contradicting the runner's retry comment and stranding jobs after Workflow startup failure. Lease recovery needs the dedicated attempt/fencing/retry policy rather than an isolated status reset.

needs-human (#12, an explicit #13 non-goal): claimIntegrity=false does not stop render or Judge egress. The visual request contains the full rendered spec and preview, so filtering safeFactualContext does not remove sensitive content. The pre-render confidentiality gate must be resolved in #12; no live provider request was made.

needs-human (#12): initial render/export claimIntegrityCheck checks claims instead of sourceClaimIds when both exist. A public claims list can hide a sensitive or unknown sourceClaimIds entry. The revision validator now checks both fields, but the inherited initial-spec path still requires the #12 confidentiality contract.

needs-human (#11, an explicit #13 non-goal): preview generation truncates screenshots to the first 20 while the API permits 100 slides. Judges can mark the deck complete using only that montage. Select a full-coverage batching/fail-closed policy in #11.

needs-human (#14): preview/production environments define only name/vars, while deployment uses --env. Generated types confirm these environments lack DB, BUCKET, MCP_SERVICE, Workflow and Container bindings, and their vars omit the router URL. Selecting isolated preview resources and the intended production bindings requires the environment decision in #14; top-level dry-run success does not validate named deployments.

needs-human: concurrent completions read MAX(version_number) outside the insertion batch and can allocate the same number. The v2 schema/unique constraints are not present in this repository, so choose the canonical migration and atomic numbering contract before changing completion/retry behavior.

needs-human: concurrent revision requests check only completed current_round and reserve no pending round, so several jobs can exceed max_rounds on completion. Decide whether pending, failed and retried revisions consume the budget before adding an atomic reservation.

needs-human: export returns succeeded even when technicalChecks fail (and an exporter can return nonzero while leaving an artifact); completeExportJob records exported without validating those checks. Decide the inherited export contract for approved-version artifacts versus rerendered artifacts and blocked/retry outcomes before changing that public job behavior.

needs-human: normalizeJudge substitutes overall score for missing everySlideScoreMin and [] for missing issues, allowing {score:99,pass:true} to pass without required evidence. Resolve the provider response schema and compatibility policy; #13 does not define or change the Judge API contract.

needs-human: ownership uses mutable GitHub login rather than stable numeric account ID. A renamed/reassigned login can lose or transfer access to existing projects. Fixing this requires an ownership/token migration and account-reconciliation policy; do not simply swap identifiers for existing data.

needs-human: refresh-token rotation reads validity, issues new tokens, then revokes the old token without a conditional atomic consume. Concurrent refreshes can both succeed. Resolve the atomic rotation and failed-issuance recovery contract against the canonical token schema.

needs-human: actual MCP CORS responses use https:// plus only the first configured hostname, unlike preflight's exact Origin handling. A second allowed origin or a localhost origin with a port fails browser CORS. Resolve whether the public allowlist contract is exact origins or hostnames before changing it.

needs-human: sleepAfter is 10m while exec permits 30m, and direct ctx.container.exec does not participate in the installed Container SDK's HTTP activity tracking. Long jobs can be stopped by onActivityExpired. Choose the active-exec lifetime/resource policy; no long-running production test was performed.

needs-human: the worker requires v2 presentation_* schema and configuration/profile seed data, but repository schema.sql/migrations only contain the older model. Identify the canonical migration source before adding or migrating tables; existing remote schema was deliberately not inspected.

needs-human: artifacts are exposed only as internal r2Key metadata; this worker has no authenticated download route or MCP resource. Confirm the intended artifact-delivery service/API before adding public endpoints or signed URLs. Direct bucket accessibility was not verified.

summary: Fixed three defects with red-to-green regressions: no-op revision patches falsely reported changedSlides, colliding source IDs overwrote R2 content, and partial uploads leaked objects. Root checks, both Worker typechecks, all 15 Worker tests, both top-level dry-run builds and a four-case Workers revision runtime smoke pass. needs-human: the full PR still includes inherited PR #1 API/schema/security/runtime decisions, including #9-#12 and #14; fixed=false means those outstanding findings prevent a clean-review or merge recommendation.
